options.content:
Hydrogeneration & propulsion

**In-between version (2026-10-05)** on the current R2.57 data. **DC power** = raw × 0.1 kW, positive when consuming. **Speed** = motor rpm (100 Hz scale), **propeller rpm** = motor rpm / 1.478. **Torque** = published % × 100 Nm (10 000 Nm scale in all four drives), at the motor shaft, in steps of 100 Nm. **Load pins** and **shear beams** in N. **Pitch and azimuth** are whole degrees, no P/D conversion. **Lever** % = (raw / 327 − 50) × 2, from the selected station.

panels.title: PCS overview
panels.description: Latest snapshot per pod. DC power = Aradex 1 + 2. Shaft power = Σ torque × speed. Torque = Aradex 1 + 2 at the motor shaft. Lever is empty when no station is selected. P/D = tan(pitch) × 2.2; empty when feathering (> 60°).

targets.rawSql:
(SELECT 'FWD' AS pod, propellor_sailing_mode__value AS mode, propellor_pitch__value AS pitch,
  CASE WHEN propellor_pitch__value < 60 THEN 2.2 * tan(radians(propellor_pitch__value)) END AS pd,
  propellor_azimuth__value AS azimuth, (SELECT (lever_raw / 327.0 - 50) * 2 FROM (SELECT timestamp, fwd_thruster_lever_speed_signal__value AS lever_raw FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_pshelm WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '1 minute' AND station_selected__value
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp, fwd_thruster_lever_speed_signal__value AS lever_raw FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_sbhelm WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '1 minute' AND station_selected__value) l ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS lever_pct, (SELECT speed__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) / 1.478 AS prop_rpm,
  ((SELECT power__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) + (SELECT power__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)) * 0.1 AS dc_power_kw, ((SELECT torque__value * speed__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) + (SELECT torque__value * speed__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)) * 100 * 2 * pi() / 60 / 1000 AS shaft_power_kw, ((SELECT torque__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) + (SELECT torque__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)) * 100 AS motor_torque_nm
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
(SELECT 'AFT' AS pod, propellor_sailing_mode__value AS mode, propellor_pitch__value AS pitch,
  CASE WHEN propellor_pitch__value < 60 THEN 2.2 * tan(radians(propellor_pitch__value)) END AS pd,
  propellor_azimuth__value AS azimuth, (SELECT (lever_raw / 327.0 - 50) * 2 FROM (SELECT timestamp, fwd_thruster_lever_speed_signal__value AS lever_raw FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_pshelm WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '1 minute' AND station_selected__value

  ((SELECT power__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara1 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) + (SELECT power__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara2 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)) * 0.1 AS dc_power_kw, ((SELECT torque__value * speed__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara1 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) + (SELECT torque__value * speed__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara2 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)) * 100 * 2 * pi() / 60 / 1000 AS shaft_power_kw, ((SELECT torque__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara1 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) + (SELECT torque__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara2 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)) * 100 AS motor_torque_nm

panels.title: A+T overview (sender=atprocessor_0)
panels.description: atprocessor_0 assumed canonical A+T sender — needs confirmation, see open question #8.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN field='boat_speed_kts' THEN value END) AS bsp,
  MAX(CASE WHEN field='app_wind_angle' THEN value END) AS awa,
  MAX(CASE WHEN field='app_wind_speed_kts' THEN value END) AS aws,
  MAX(CASE WHEN field='heel_angle_deg' THEN value END) AS heel,
  MAX(CASE WHEN field='signed_leeway' THEN value END) AS leeway,
  MAX(CASE WHEN field='rudder_angle_deg' THEN value END) AS rudder
FROM (
  SELECT field, value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY field ORDER BY timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM public.atpx_raw
  WHERE sender = 'atprocessor_0' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND field IN ('boat_speed_kts','app_wind_angle','app_wind_speed_kts','heel_angle_deg','signed_leeway','rudder_angle_deg')
) t
WHERE rn = 1

panels.title: DC power per pod
panels.description: Aradex 1 + 2 DC power per pod. Positive = consuming.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  (avg(CASE WHEN drive = 1 THEN power END) + avg(CASE WHEN drive = 2 THEN power END)) * 0.1 AS "FWD"
FROM (SELECT timestamp, 1 AS drive, speed__value AS speed, torque__value AS torque, power__value AS power FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp, 2 AS drive, speed__value AS speed, torque__value AS torque, power__value AS power FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) a
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

  (avg(CASE WHEN drive = 1 THEN power END) + avg(CASE WHEN drive = 2 THEN power END)) * 0.1 AS "AFT"

  SELECT timestamp, 2 AS drive, speed__value AS speed, torque__value AS torque, power__value AS power FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara2 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) a

WHERE sender='atprocessor_0' AND field='boat_speed_kts' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql:
SELECT propellor_sailing_mode__value AS "Mode", action_level_1_tm_12_active__value AS "Thrust mode (R54, not published)",
  propellor_pitch__value AS "Pitch [deg]",
  CASE WHEN propellor_pitch__value < 60 THEN 2.2 * tan(radians(propellor_pitch__value)) END AS "P/D",
  propellor_azimuth__value AS "Azimuth [deg]",
  (SELECT (lever_raw / 327.0 - 50) * 2 FROM (SELECT timestamp, fwd_thruster_lever_speed_signal__value AS lever_raw FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_pshelm WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '1 minute' AND station_selected__value

  SELECT timestamp, fwd_thruster_lever_speed_signal__value AS lever_raw FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_sbhelm WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '1 minute' AND station_selected__value) l ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Lever [%]",
  CASE WHEN (SELECT station_selected__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_pshelm ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) THEN 'PS'

  (SELECT vp_enable__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Drive 2 enabled",
  (SELECT speed_or_torque_setpoint__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS "SpeedOrTorqueSetpoint (constant)",
  (SELECT max_power_setpoint_motor__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS "PMS motoring limit d1 [kW]",
  (SELECT max_power_setpoint_generator__value FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS "PMS generating limit d1 [kW]",

ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: FWD — torque per drive and shear beams
panels.description: Left: the torque each Aradex drive's winding set puts on the motor shaft (before the 1.478 gearbox), published as whole % of 10 000 Nm, so in steps of 100 Nm. It saturates at ±1000 Nm. Right: R13, the shear beam torque. It should be Nm, but reads as a force in N: on AFT about −0.43 N per Nm propeller torque, on FWD about 1.25× that. Moves to the Nm axis once the PLC sends Nm.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(CASE WHEN drive = 1 THEN torque END) * 100 AS "Drive 1",
  avg(CASE WHEN drive = 2 THEN torque END) * 100 AS "Drive 2"
FROM (SELECT timestamp, 1 AS drive, speed__value AS speed, torque__value AS torque, power__value AS power FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp, 2 AS drive, speed__value AS speed, torque__value AS torque, power__value AS power FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) a
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, avg(shear_beam_calculated__value) AS "Shear beams (R13)"
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: FWD — power
panels.description: DC power per drive (raw × 0.1 kW, positive = consuming) and shaft power from Σ torque × speed. The gap is drive and motor losses plus the 100 Nm torque rounding, which is large at low torque.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(CASE WHEN drive = 1 THEN power END) * 0.1 AS "DC drive 1",
  avg(CASE WHEN drive = 2 THEN power END) * 0.1 AS "DC drive 2",
  (avg(CASE WHEN drive = 1 THEN torque * speed END) + avg(CASE WHEN drive = 2 THEN torque * speed END))
    * 100 * 2 * pi() / 60 / 1000 AS "Shaft (torque × speed)"
FROM (SELECT timestamp, 1 AS drive, speed__value AS speed, torque__value AS torque, power__value AS power FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp, 2 AS drive, speed__value AS speed, torque__value AS torque, power__value AS power FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) a
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: FWD — propeller speed
panels.description: Propeller rpm = Aradex motor rpm / 1.478, signed (R55, the propeller speed, is not published). Dashed: the specified propulsion/maneuvering speed for the lever position, linear with a ±5 % deadband (100 % = 500 rpm); meaningful only in modes 2 and 3.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(CASE WHEN drive = 1 THEN speed END) / 1.478 AS "Prop rpm (drive 1)",
  avg(CASE WHEN drive = 2 THEN speed END) / 1.478 AS "Prop rpm (drive 2)"
FROM (SELECT timestamp, 1 AS drive, speed__value AS speed, torque__value AS torque, power__value AS power FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp, 2 AS drive, speed__value AS speed, torque__value AS torque, power__value AS power FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) a
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(CASE WHEN abs((lever_raw / 327.0 - 50) * 2) < 5 THEN 0 ELSE (lever_raw / 327.0 - 50) * 2 END) * 500 / 100 AS "Specified rpm for lever"
FROM (SELECT timestamp, fwd_thruster_lever_speed_signal__value AS lever_raw FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_pshelm WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND station_selected__value
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp, fwd_thruster_lever_speed_signal__value AS lever_raw FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_sbhelm WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND station_selected__value) l
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Grey lines: Dykstra reference curves CP1–CP4. Dots: $avg_window buckets in HydroGen mode only, generated power = −(Aradex 1 + 2 DC power), coloured by pitch in degrees. Large square: the last $avg_window, also only in HydroGen. Empty until the pods run in HydroGen.

targets.rawSql:
WITH pitch_b AS (
  SELECT date_bin('$avg_window', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS bucket, avg(propellor_pitch__value) AS pitch,
    min(propellor_sailing_mode__value) AS mode_min, max(propellor_sailing_mode__value) AS mode_max
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  GROUP BY 1
),
power_b AS (
  SELECT date_bin('$avg_window', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS bucket,
    -(avg(CASE WHEN drive = 1 THEN power END) + avg(CASE WHEN drive = 2 THEN power END)) * 0.1 AS power_kw
  FROM (SELECT timestamp, 1 AS drive, speed__value AS speed, torque__value AS torque, power__value AS power FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp, 2 AS drive, speed__value AS speed, torque__value AS torque, power__value AS power FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) a
  GROUP BY 1
),
bsp_b AS (
  SELECT date_bin('$avg_window', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS bucket, avg(value) AS vs_kts
  FROM public.atpx_raw
  WHERE sender='atprocessor_0' AND field='boat_speed_kts' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT b.bucket AS time, b.vs_kts, p.power_kw, pi.pitch
FROM bsp_b b
JOIN power_b p ON b.bucket = p.bucket
JOIN pitch_b pi ON b.bucket = pi.bucket
WHERE pi.mode_min = 4 AND pi.mode_max = 4
ORDER BY b.bucket

WITH pitch_c AS (
  SELECT avg(propellor_pitch__value) AS pitch, min(propellor_sailing_mode__value) AS mode_min
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd
  WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$avg_window'
),
power_c AS (
  SELECT -(avg(CASE WHEN drive = 1 THEN power END) + avg(CASE WHEN drive = 2 THEN power END)) * 0.1 AS power_kw
  FROM (SELECT timestamp, 1 AS drive, speed__value AS speed, torque__value AS torque, power__value AS power FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1 WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$avg_window'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp, 2 AS drive, speed__value AS speed, torque__value AS torque, power__value AS power FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2 WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$avg_window') a
),
bsp_c AS (
  SELECT avg(value) AS vs_kts
  FROM public.atpx_raw
  WHERE sender='atprocessor_0' AND field='boat_speed_kts' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$avg_window'
)
SELECT bsp_c.vs_kts, power_c.power_kw, pitch_c.pitch
FROM bsp_c, power_c, pitch_c
WHERE pitch_c.mode_min = 4
